items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Nat Hentoff had said at the time, “Sheila has always had the ultimate confidence...” [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Of course. I’m doing everything I want to do in my life today, it’s teaching, it’s talking to people like you and going out and doing concerts. I’m constantly working. You know I never though I’d have to turn down gigs, how about that?

Wow. All right. You know early on we had mentioned your Blue Note album, 1962, and Nat Hentoff had said at the time, “Sheila has always had the ultimate confidence, a refusal to compromise.” That was way back in ’62 he said that.
